metadata.purpose: Generate, validate, and refine research hypotheses using a multi-stage cognitive process.

module_1_semantic_exploration.description: Deconstructs the research problem into core components.

steps.action: Identify the main concepts (nouns and verbs) in the research question.
steps.instruction: Output a list of 3-5 key terms.

steps.action: Analyze the problem using the 5 Ws: Who (Subject), What (Phenomenon), When (Timeframe), Where (Location), Why (Cause/Effect).
steps.instruction: Fill the matrix: [Who, What, When, Where, Why].

module_2_variable_mapping.description: Identifies and categorizes variables (Module 3 in architecture).

categories.independent: The cause or predictor variable (manipulated or observed).
categories.control: Variables kept constant to isolate the relationship.
categories.mediating: Variables that explain the mechanism (How X affects Y).
categories.moderating: Variables that change the strength/direction of the relationship (When X affects Y).

operational_definition_template.structure: Name of Variable + Concept (What it is) + Indicator (How it is measured).
operational_definition_template.example: Estrés Laboral (Concepto) medido mediante la escala Maslach Burnout Inventory (Indicador).

module_3_creative_generation.description: Generates hypothesis candidates using different logical templates (Module 4).

types.template: El [Grupo] presenta niveles [Alto/Bajo] de [Variable Dependiente] en [Contexto].
Existe una relación [Positiva/Negativa] entre [Variable Independiente] y [Variable Dependiente].
La [Variable Independiente] provoca/genera un cambio en [Variable Dependiente].
types.logic: Predicts cause-and-effect (requires experimental design or strong theory).

types.template: No existe relación significativa entre [Variable Independiente] y [Variable Dependiente].
types.logic: The default assumption to be rejected.
Predicts the specific direction of the relationship.

types.template: Se anticipa que [Fenómeno Central] varía en función de [Contexto/Experiencia].
types.logic: Working hypothesis (Hipótesis de Trabajo) or anticipation of meaning for qualitative inquiry.

module_4_validation_checklist.description: Filters candidates based on scientific rigor (Module 5).
checks: Is Testable? (Can it be proven false?)
Has Variables? (At least 1 IV and 1 DV unless descriptive)
Clarity Score (Is it free of ambiguity?)
Relevance (Does it answer the Research Question?)
Ethical Compliance (Does testing it harm subjects?)
module_4_validation_checklist.scoring_threshold: Must pass 5/5 checks to be accepted.

module_5_simulation_projection.description: Anticipates requirements for testing the hypothesis (Module 5).
projections: Statistical Test Required (e.g., T-Test, ANOVA, Pearson Correlation)

module_6_testing_framework.description: Maps hypotheses to specific statistical tests and defines testing parameters (Module 6).

descriptive_hypothesis.when_to_use: When hypothesis predicts a single variable's state or level.

correlational_hypothesis.when_to_use: When hypothesis predicts association without causation.

null_hypothesis.tests: Same as the alternative hypothesis type — null is tested by failing to reject.

effect_size_guidance.description: Effect size quantifies the magnitude of the relationship, independent of sample size.

power_analysis.description: Determines the minimum sample size needed to detect an effect of a given size.

parameters.power: Probability of detecting a true effect (typically 0.80)
parameters.effect_size: Expected magnitude (use Cohen's conventions if unknown)

module_7_iterative_refinement.description: Refines hypotheses based on literature review feedback and manages multiple hypotheses (Module 7).

post_literature_review_adjustment.description: After reviewing the literature, hypotheses may need refinement.
triggers: New variables discovered in literature that mediate or moderate the relationship.
Prior studies show opposite direction than initially predicted.
The theoretical framework suggests a more specific mechanism.
Sample characteristics differ from original assumptions.
Measurement instruments found in literature suggest different operationalization.
adjustment_protocol: 2. Identify the specific finding or theory that prompts the change.
3. Formulate the refined hypothesis (H1.1) with explicit justification.
5. Update the simulation projection (module_5) with new test requirements.

hypothesis_versioning.description: Track hypothesis evolution through the research process.

changelog_template.change_type: Direction change | Variable addition | Scope narrowing | Operationalization change

multi_hypothesis_management.description: Strategies for handling multiple hypotheses in a single study.

hierarchy.primary_hypothesis: The main prediction that directly answers the research question. Only ONE per study.
hierarchy.secondary_hypotheses: Additional predictions about sub-questions, mediators, or moderators.
hierarchy.exploratory_hypotheses: Tentative predictions without strong theoretical backing, clearly labeled.

naming_convention.null: H0 (Paired with each alternative: H0₁, H0₂...)

correction_for_multiple_testing.problem: Testing multiple hypotheses increases the chance of Type I errors (false positives).

qualitative_hypothesis_clarification.description: In qualitative research, formal hypotheses are replaced by working assumptions.

terminology.working_hypothesis: Tentative anticipation of meaning, NOT a prediction to be tested statistically.
terminology.research_propositions: Theoretical statements that guide inquiry without constraining findings.
terminology.sensitizing_concepts: Conceptual frameworks that orient attention without predetermining outcomes.

qualitative_hypothesis_clarification.when_to_use_qualitative_type: Use the 'Qualitative' template from module_3 ONLY when the study has a qualitative approach AND the researcher wants to articulate initial anticipations.
